heroHeadline: Russia Launches Combined Phased Strike on Ukraine Energy Grid — 8 Killed in Dnipropetrovsk; Ukrainian Drones Hit Astrakhan Gas Plant
heroSubtitle: Russia escalated its post-ceasefire bombing campaign on May 13 with a coordinated phased attack: an initial Shahed drone wave to saturate Ukrainian air defenses, followed by cruise missiles and ballistic missiles targeting energy infrastructure, military-industrial facilities, and government buildings across eight regions including Lutsk, Rivne, Kharkiv, Odesa, Cherkasy, Kryvyi Rih, Dnipropetrovsk, and Poltava. At least 8 civilians were killed and 11 injured in Dnipropetrovsk Oblast alone. Ukraine's STING Drone Hunters intercepted 100+ Shahed drones. Meanwhile, Ukrainian strike drones penetrated Russian air defenses overnight and struck the Astrakhan gas processing plant in southern Russia near the Caspian Sea — the latest in a deep-strike campaign that has hit Russian energy infrastructure from Leningrad Oblast to the Caspian. Russia claimed 286 Ukrainian drones were downed across all Russian regions. Russia's estimated military casualties have reached approximately 1,344,290 since Feb. 24, 2022. Day 1,539 of the full-scale invasion.
